# Workspace Instructions

- Build a Spanish-language prospecting CRM for local businesses using Vite, vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
- Keep the app responsive, fast, accessible, and usable without a backend.
- Persist prospects and theme preference in `localStorage`.
- Support searching, status filters, prospect create/edit/delete, quick status changes, WhatsApp links, and dashboard metrics.
- Keep UI copy in Spanish and preserve the existing visual system when extending the app.
- Run the production build after meaningful changes and keep `README.md` current.
